newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks seen opening mixed to lower.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks seen opening mixed to lower.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were seen opening mixed to lower on Monday, with the markets enjoying a bit of a breather after Friday's 101.6-point gain by the Dow Jones Industrial Average.
Analysts said the markets likely would be led by high-technology stocks, especially small- and mid-capitalized companies whose stocks are seen as undervalued.
"We should have a little profit-taking after Friday's spectacular rise," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments.
